name: smwmusic-secret-of-evermore-lonely-halls
title: Secret of Evermore - Lonely Halls
description:
This song, sometimes also called Dog Maze, is a cloudy emotional tune from Secret of Evermore. It's probably most useful for gloomy or dark areas.
This is not intended to be a 1:1 port; I strived to create a sound which was more spacious than the original. In addition, while I used SOE samples, I edited them to clean them up a bit. The instruments/notes themselves are as accurate as I could get them though.

Update 2020-08-08:
made the melody echo more realistic during the first few seconds of the song
used remote codes to drop the insert size
A number of loops are added reducing the insert size more
replaced most = commands with more readable note lengths
